papers.what_it_is: A review by Dunjko and Briegel of research at the interplay of machine learning, artificial intelligence and quantum information, covering classical background, ML for physics, quantum generalizations of learning, quantum speed-ups for ML, and quantum learning agents.

papers.what_it_is: A Yale-led perspective article that reviews cited work and outlines proposals for simulating chemistry (vibronic spectra, dynamics, graph problems, electronic structure) on bosonic cQED quantum devices, without running any new experiment.

assertions.value: The authors state that this perspective reviews recent progress and future potential of using bosonic quantum devices for a wide range of challenging chemical problems, and that it focuses on a qumode-based platform that uses circuit quantum electrodynamics (cQED).
quotes: In this perspective, we review recent progress and future potential of using bosonic quantum devices for addressing a wide range of challenging chemical problems
In this paper, we focus on a promising experimental realization of a qumode-based platform that uses circuit quantum electrodynamics (cQED).
